task1.title: How the biofuel ethanol is produced
task1.prompt: The diagram below shows how a biofuel called ethanol is produced.

chartDesc.title: Biofuel production: how ethanol is made

stages.label: Plants and trees grow
stages.detail: Plants and trees grow using energy from sunlight and carbon dioxide.

stages.label: Harvesting
stages.detail: Grown plants and trees are harvested by machinery.

stages.label: Pre-processing
stages.detail: Harvested material is pre-processed in equipment to produce cellulose.

stages.label: Processing
stages.detail: Cellulose is processed in a laboratory or processing plant.

stages.label: Microbes added
stages.detail: Microbes are added to the sugars to ferment them into ethanol.

stages.label: Ethanol
stages.detail: Ethanol is created and used as biofuel for transport such as cars, trucks, and airplanes.

stages.label: Carbon Dioxide emission
stages.detail: Vehicles running on ethanol release carbon dioxide back into the atmosphere, which is reused by plants.

chartDesc.overview: The process is a continuous cycle showing how ethanol biofuel is produced from plants and trees through harvesting, pre-processing, chemical processing into sugars, and microbial fermentation, with the carbon dioxide emitted by transport returning to feed plant growth.
keyFeatures: Cyclical process ending and restarting with carbon dioxide
Inputs required at stage 1: Energy (sunlight + carbon dioxide)
Chemical transformations: plant material -> cellulose -> sugars -> ethanol
Transport uses (cars, trucks, airplanes) release carbon dioxide that restarts the cycle

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
